newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn issues 4.75 bln dmk in 5-yr Bobls - Buba.
newsitem.headline: Bonn issues 4.75 bln dmk in 5-yr Bobls - Buba.

text.p: The German government on Wednesday issued 4.75 billion marks in Series 120 five-year Bobl bonds at an auction at a lowest accepted price of 101.50, said the Bundesbank, the issuing agent.
The weighted average price was 101.58, and the average yield was 4.61 percent, the Bundesbank said in a statement.
The Bundesbank said a total of 1.54 billion marks had been issued on tap to non-bank investors like private individuals and charities before tap issuance ceased on Tuesday.
The Bundesbank said it was retaining 1.71 billion marks of the issue for market-smoothing purposes, bringing the total volume of the Series 120 Bobl issue to eight billion marks.
The German securities number is WKN 114120.
